shared_or_similar_visual_information: Circular marker at the edge of a marked interval or at a point on a plotted trace. Compare the upper mark at x=1 on the left with the mark at 3 on the number line on the right.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The point (1,4) is excluded while the same input is still defined by f(1)=1. Right image: The displayed set excludes 3 at its upper bound.
Rationales: On the left, the hollow marker excludes its plotted height only. The filled marker vertically aligned with it supplies the actual output at that input. On the right, the hollow endpoint marks a strict boundary of the marked ray.
